_paths: repo_name falls back to the directory name when empty. app_path is the deployed copy `wall verify --app` compares MANIFEST.sha256 against; leave empty if the repo is not deployed as a separate tree.

fast_track._identity: Per-invocation commit identity for `wall fast-track --commit`. Agents never write `git config`: it is repo-global, and one agent's write lands on another agent's in-flight commit (RECONCILIATION G1). Left empty, the command refuses to commit rather than guessing.

definition_of_done: every acceptance criterion maps to a source
CI green or fast-track route confirmed
mutation evidence recorded for every new guard
every new public symbol is named by at least one test
SAST and secrets lane read; every finding fixed or refuted
test durations recorded; no shard map hand-edited
warden sign-off recorded for in-scope arcs; every declared data use carries a verdict
_integrations: Optional host seams; absent or null means the wall stays a purely read-only static page. queue_api = {health, queue, add}: same-origin paths to the host's work-queue REST surface. The page shows EXECUTE buttons (per item detail + per arc) ONLY after GET health answers {ok:true}; EXECUTE POSTs add with {source:'wall_click', priority:'P2', directive: execute_item|execute_arc, target_key|target_arch, title}. agents_feed: a same-origin path to a live wave-status JSON ({updated, headcount:{developers,researchers,cap}, completed, in_progress, new}) rendered on the CREW tab, polled every 5s while that tab is open.

research._comment: none | allowlist | session-default. Local-only by default; researchers state the mode in every finding. See .claude/agents/researcher.md section 2.

budget.advisory: Advisory only. Nothing here stops work — it tells you when to.
budget._pacing: The courier enriches each meter from run_end events: used_total, pct_remaining, measured velocity/day, a projected exhaustion date, and a pace verdict (slow / on pace / may speed / idle / unknown / exhausted) that CAPACITY_REBALANCING.md consumes. match_model attributes in+out tokens by model_used substring; counts attributes gh_minutes or cost_usd. strict=true marks a hard list-price cap: a projected early exhaustion becomes mandatory pacing, not advice. period_start/period_end (ISO) override the default calendar month.
